questions.question: What does chapter 28 mainly describe?
options: The regular daily and festival offerings
The battles fought east of the Jordan
The numbering of the new generation
The laws of clean and unclean food
questions.answer: The regular daily and festival offerings

questions.question: What offering was made every day, morning and evening?

A male goat for a sin offering
A young bull from the herd
